# crease/ui

crease/ui is an MIT-licensed, source-owned component distribution for Foldkit.
It ports the shadcn/ui visual language and CSS token contract while keeping
Foldkit's Elm-style architecture authoritative for state and behavior.

Canonical resources:
- Documentation: https://creaseui.com/
- Repository: https://github.com/Potti1234/creaseui
- Architecture: https://github.com/Potti1234/creaseui/blob/main/docs/architecture.md
- Component catalog: https://github.com/Potti1234/creaseui/blob/main/docs/component-catalog.md
- Parity ledger: https://github.com/Potti1234/creaseui/blob/main/docs/component-parity.md
- Registry guide: https://github.com/Potti1234/creaseui/blob/main/docs/registry.md

Installation:
- `npx creaseui init`
- `npx creaseui add button dialog`
- `npx creaseui diff dialog`

Rules for generated code:
- Stateful Foldkit UI primitives keep Model, Message, update, and OutMessage.
- Embed stateful children with `h.submodel` and wrap messages with `Got*`.
- Stateless helpers are direct view functions and do not become submodels.
- Model, update, init, and view stay pure; side effects use Commands, Flags,
  Subscriptions, Mounts, or ManagedResources according to their cause.
- Use the semantic theme tokens rather than hard-coded component colors.
- Use one effective `h.Class` attribute per element and merge classes with `cn`.
- Prefer the crease/ui registry source over recreating raw accessible widgets.
